Strategy: Take the upper-quartile bin. Prefer the bin ranking three quarters up among all open bins, counting residuals below it, roomy but skipping the very loosest bins and ignoring tight outliers. This keeps the loosest bins for big items and the tightest for exact fits, so ranking can differ from Best Fit whenever the quartile bin is not the tightest. It may help by keeping bins usable longer, but may fail by passing up tight fills for roomy bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    n = len(bins)
    return [-abs(sum([1 for s in bins if s < r]) - (n - 1) * 3 / 4) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Upper-quartile rank targeting: prefer bin whose residual rank is closest to 3*(n-1)/4.
